items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Carlos Gastel was their manager... Carlos Gastel at one time... he said, 'Hey kid, you want to join the band?'... I finally joined the band after playing with it... Carlos Gastel, I finally joined the band

ctx.x: And you’re the ride man, right? You’re the hot player.

Yeah, I had such a great time really, it was just marvelous. And then of course they became my guardians and got permission from my folks. Like I lived with them, I was 15 and I graduated at 16, but I went right on and stayed there at Purdue because Paul Reegy had the orchestra, and so I remember the second year we had a gig for the whole summer at Sylvania, Ohio, right below Toledo, at a big open quarry. And the band was going to be there all summer and I think they were bringing in name bands every other week…
